title: Glowing cherries
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9966' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff5544' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff5544' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff6655'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ee3322'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#aa1100'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='cherryGrad2' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff7766'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#dd2211'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#991100'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='highlight' cx='30%' cy='25%' r='30%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0.8'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffffff' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- outer glow halos -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='68' r='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='30' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- stems -->
  <path d='M38 46 Q42 30 50 20 Q55 14 62 12' stroke='#66cc44' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 42 Q66 28 62 12' stroke='#55bb33' stroke-width='3.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- leaf -->
  <path d='M50 20 Q58 15 64 18 Q60 24 52 22 Z' fill='#77dd55'/>
  <path d='M52 22 Q58 20 62 19' stroke='#55aa33' stroke-width='1' fill='none'/>

  <!-- left cherry -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='22' fill='url(#cherryGrad)'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='68' r='22' fill='none' stroke='#cc2211' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='29' cy='60' rx='8' ry='6' fill='url(#highlight)' transform='rotate(-20 29 60)'/>

  <!-- right cherry -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='20' fill='url(#cherryGrad2)'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='62' r='20' fill='none' stroke='#bb1100' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='55' rx='7' ry='5' fill='url(#highlight)' transform='rotate(-25 62 55)'/>

  <!-- dimples / stem attachment points -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='48' r='3' fill='#bb2211'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='44' r='2.5' fill='#aa1100'/>

  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='80' r='1.5' fill='#ffcc88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='48' r='1.5' fill='#ffcc88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='85' r='1' fill='#ffddaa' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='72' r='1' fill='#ffddaa' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
